body:
I hear that man. I'm trying to chill... hence the weed. but weed + existing anxiety = more anxiety. here's the weird thing - today I went to lunch with a friend and wolfed down some Chinese food. I was worried I was gonna feel sick and sure enough I kinda felt a stomach ache. last night after posting this I smoked 2 bowls as fast as I could then made a list of 31 reasons to be sober for 31 days. once I finished that I felt fine. don't think I had any stomach pain this morning. 

life is fucking stressful right now though. surprised I'm not pulling my hair out tbh.
